The method for deciding the outcome when the <c:ffff00>time<c>
<c:ffff00>limit<c> reaches 0 in a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> without either <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c>
having been <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>.

The teams are compared by these criteria: 1)
number of <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c> {{knocked_out}}; 2) number of
<c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>; 3) total <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> dealt.
Comparison starts with criterion 1 and, if tied,
moves on to the next.
